home_establishment.owns: cold permanent unit topology, stable unit IDs, home standards and source claims

materialized_unit.owns: current exact homogeneous unit state and deviations

commander_assignment.owns: which person commands which units and delegated authority

formation.owns: temporary operational arrangement of existing units

unit_invariant: One unit has one troop type and one intended standard loadout. A durable subset change in loadout, doctrine, training, commander, mount standard or independent assignment requires splitting that subset into its own unit first.
split_example: A 5,000-infantry unit whose 1,000-person subset receives a different standard loadout becomes a 4,000-infantry unit plus a 1,000-infantry unit before the new loadout is applied.
commander_rule: A commander is a separate person and may command one or several units subject to command capacity. Commander stats affect control/order/synchronization/morale mechanics, never soldier physical-stat averages.
formation_rule: Formation arranges units for an operation/battle and never changes ownership, troop type, loadout or unit identity.
support_rule: Support organizations remain targetable and casualty-bearing but contribute only their appropriate support/self-defense capability unless explicitly and lawfully committed.
